defects.title: Archived products link returns 404
defects.description: The main navigation links to /products/archive, which the defective variant answers with 404.
defects.rationale: A client following the navigation link sees status 404. Fixture probe: structural ground truth only; detection by a QA Sentinel check is measured later.

defects.title: Checkout confirmation link returns 500
defects.description: The cart page links to /checkout/confirm, which the defective variant answers with 500.
defects.rationale: A client following the cart page link sees status 500. Fixture probe: structural ground truth only.

defects.title: Cart script throws when evaluated
defects.description: /js/cart.js throws an error when evaluated in the defective variant. The page references it with a script tag.
defects.rationale: The served script text throws under bare V8 evaluation (node:vm, not a security boundary). This does not show that a browser raises a page error; browser runtime-error detection is the browser pack's job.

defects.title: Promo script logs console.error
defects.description: /js/promo.js calls console.error when evaluated in the defective variant. The page references it with a script tag.
defects.rationale: The served script text calls console.error under bare V8 evaluation with a stub console. It does not show that a browser surfaces a console message; that is the browser pack's job.

defects.title: Home page references a missing stylesheet
defects.description: The home page references /assets/missing.css, which the defective variant answers with 404.
defects.rationale: The referenced asset returns 404. Capturing it as a failed network request in a browser is the browser pack's job.

defects.title: Product image has no alt attribute
defects.description: The products page renders a product image without an alt attribute in the defective variant. The axe-core rule expected to flag it is image-alt.
defects.rationale: Structural ground truth only: the defect is planted in the markup. That axe-core detects it is unconfirmed until the browser pack runs @axe-core/playwright (Phase 2 or 3); if it does not, this entry must be reclassified by a reviewed change.

defects.title: Search input has no label
defects.description: The home page renders the search input without an accessible label in the defective variant. The axe-core rule expected to flag it is label.
defects.rationale: Structural ground truth only: the defect is planted in the markup. That axe-core detects it is unconfirmed until the browser pack runs @axe-core/playwright (Phase 2 or 3); if it does not, this entry must be reclassified by a reviewed change.

defects.title: Home page lacks X-Content-Type-Options
defects.description: The defective variant omits X-Content-Type-Options from the response for /. The clean variant sends it.
defects.rationale: A client sees that the header is absent on the response. Fixture probe: structural ground truth only.

defects.title: Products page lacks Content-Security-Policy
defects.description: The defective variant omits Content-Security-Policy from the response for /products. The clean variant sends it.
defects.rationale: A client sees that the header is absent on the response. Fixture probe: structural ground truth only.

defects.title: Catalog export is oversized
defects.description: /catalog/export returns a 2 MiB (2097152 byte) body in the defective variant and a 4096 byte body in the clean variant.
defects.rationale: The byte length is deterministic and differs between variants. Size is evaluated separately from time.

defects.title: Daily report responds slowly
defects.description: /reports/daily waits 1500 ms before responding in the defective variant. The clean variant responds immediately with an identical body.
defects.rationale: Measured with a monotonic clock against a 1000 ms threshold with a generous margin; sensitive to machine load and not a claim about general performance reliability.

defects.title: Newsletter form has no submit control
defects.description: The newsletter page renders a signup form without any submit control in the defective variant.
defects.rationale: Structural ground truth only: the defect is planted in the markup. Read-only form structure inspection by the browser pack is a later measurement.

defects.title: Cart total ignores line quantity
defects.description: /cart computes its total from unit prices without multiplying by quantity in the defective variant.
defects.rationale: Recognising it needs an independent authored expectation; no built-in pack has one. Reported as its own group, outside the AC-01 detectable denominator. The manifest carries no expected value.

defects.title: Order discount applied twice
defects.description: /cart/summary applies the order discount twice in the defective variant.
defects.rationale: Recognising it needs an independent authored expectation; no built-in pack has one. Reported as its own group, outside the AC-01 detectable denominator. The manifest carries no expected value.
